On 30 September 1951, [[Galway GAA|Galway]] won the title after a 2-11 to 2-8 win over [[New York GAA|New York]] in the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/ArticleForm.aspx?ID=109930|title=When New York were feared|publisher=Hogan Stand|date=10 April 2009|access-date=23 February 2016}} It was their 2nd league title
